The artifact declares accepting states that are not tied to a well-formed goal RM for this task; per-state semantics are unclear. More importantly: (3) Reward safety: progress rewards are given as +0.05 for partial achievements (taking key, moving ball), which is dense but bounded and fine in sign, yet the violation states u3 assign reward -1.0 on the entering transition and nothing after; there is no negative step reward while remaining in u3, so a violating agent pays a one-time penalty and then accumulates zero — the episode never terminates on violation (target pickup ends it), so the agent can accumulate further +0.05-free steps, but critically the FINAL acceptance of u2/u3/u4 as accepting states means any agent that merely moves the ball (u2) reaches an accepting state, contradicting the 'never both' task and rewarding a subgoal as terminal. (2) The -1.0 reward combined with a possible later 1.0 makes the net signal confusing, and since u2 is a sink without target_picked_up transition, episodes where the agent legitimately reached u2 via blocker_moved & has_door_key can never complete, unfairly punishing all paths that pass through that joint event even when it did not constitute a violation of the intended semantics. Also note the event blocker_moved & has_door_key occurring simultaneously is essentially impossible (pick up the ball vs. pick up the key are different steps), so the -1.0 branch is nearly dead code while the real violation path (has_door_key then blocker_moved in either order) is still routed through u1/u2 with positive rewards. Regressions: blocker_moved can become false (ball dropped back) but no state transition models regression; key_lost is never used. Compactness: u2 is only reachable via an almost-impossible simultaneous event, yet it is a mandatory accepting path, which makes accepting states largely unreachable except via (u0,target_picked_up)->u3. Recommend rejecting and requiring an RM that makes the forbidden conjunction a permanent non-accepting sink (or latch) with no path to FINAL_STATES, while keeping dense bounded progress rewards and explicit regressions for blocker_moved.
